idea-plugin.name: Sharp Studio Dark
idea-plugin.description:
Sharp Studio Dark gives JetBrains Rider the look of Visual Studio 2026 — built for C# developers who live in Visual Studio but want their Rider to feel the same.

Same IDE you know, familiar colours underneath: the chrome, the editor palette and the icons all follow Visual Studio 2026 (Dark).

What you get
  • A Visual Studio 2026 dark chrome. Every colour was sampled from a real Visual Studio window instead of guessed: title bar #1C1C1C, menu and toolbar strip #262626, tool windows #282828, editor #1E1E1E, status bar #141414, and the flat grey selection with the blue underline on the active tab that Visual Studio uses instead of a coloured highlight.
  • A colour scheme named Sharp Studio Dark with the editor colours you already read every day: keywords #569CD6, strings #D69D85, numbers #B5CEA8, types #4EC9B0, methods #DCDCAA, comments #57A64A.
  • 210 hand-drawn icons over 719 platform paths. Green C# files, grey window tiles with the blue globe for web projects and the purple C# mark for class libraries and solutions, golden folders, photo-frame images, flat monochrome toolbars — the same visual language as Visual Studio, drawn from scratch for Rider.
  • Nothing but resources. No background services, no code running in your IDE, no telemetry: a theme descriptor, one colour scheme and SVG files.
Good to know
  • Enable it in Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance: Theme = Sharp Studio Dark, Editor color scheme = Sharp Studio Dark (re-select them once after the first install).
  • Verified on Rider 2025.1 – 2026.x. If another icon-pack plugin is installed (VSCode Icons, Catppuccin Icons, …) it wins over any theme's icons, so disable it if you want the Visual Studio icons to show.
  • Dark theme only. Suggestions, bug reports and icon requests are welcome in the issue tracker.
Support the project
Sharp Studio Dark is free and stays free. If it saves you time, a coffee is welcome: buy me a coffee via PayPal.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — first release
  • Visual Studio 2026 (Dark) chrome: title bar, menu and toolbar strip, tool windows, editor tabs with the blue active-tab underline, dark status bar and flat grey selection.
  • Editor colour scheme Sharp Studio Dark with the Visual Studio palette (keywords, strings, numbers, types, methods, comments, selection and caret colours).
  • Icon pack with 210 icons covering 719 platform paths: green C# files, grey window tiles with the blue globe badge for web projects and the purple C# mark for class libraries and solutions, golden folders, photo-frame images and flat monochrome toolbar icons.
  • Message boxes, buttons and the window frame deliberately keep Rider's own look, so dialogs stay stock and readable.
